# IMDb basic exploratory data analysis

```{r}
# Change backslashes to forward slashes
library(summarytools)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
movies <- read.csv("C:/Users/masar/Downloads/Data Recolection - Data Recolection.csv")
# put the dataset in the same folder as project so you don't need to write the complete path to the file

head(movies)

```

```{r}
movies$IMDb
```

## IMDb mean

```{r}
mean(movies$IMDb)
```

## IMDb Median

```{r}
median(movies$IMDb)
```

## IMDb Range

```{r}
range(movies$IMDb)
```

## IMDb Variance

```{r}
var(movies$IMDb)
```

## IMDb Standard Deviation

```{r}
sd(movies$IMDb)
```

## IMDb Histogram

```{r}
movies$Budget..Millions.USD. <- as.numeric(movies$Budget..Millions.USD.)
# movies$Budget.Millions.USD.
```

```{r}
chart_imdb + 
  geom_histogram(aes(y=after_stat(density)),bins = 10,color = 1, fill = "white") +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.25,lwd = 1, colour = "4",
               fill = "blue") +
  labs(title = "Histogram for IMDb ratings",
       x = "Ratings",
       y = "Density")
```

## IMDb Boxplot

```{r}
movies |>
  ggplot(aes(x=IMDb)) +
  geom_boxplot()
```
